q: Can I do waterproofing myself in Australia?
issue: Claims "In most Australian states, waterproofing wet areas like bathrooms and balconies must be carried out or signed off by a licensed waterproofer, since it is classed as restricted building work." "Restricted building work" is a specific NSW Home Building Act licensing classification, not a term or classification used uniformly by other states' regulators — presenting it as a general "most Australian states" fact overstates a jurisdiction-specific rule.
suggestedFix: Soften to a verifiably nationwide claim (e.g. "waterproofing wet areas is licensed trade work in every state, though the specific classification and sign-off rules vary — check your local regulator") rather than citing NSW's specific "restricted building work" term as a national standard.
